---
title: "Home runs"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
shortened_seasons <- c(1918, 1919, 1981, 1994, 1995, 2020)

hr_by_season <- Teams |>
  group_by(yearID) |>
  summarise(
    total_HR = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_team_games = sum(G, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    HR_per_game = total_HR / total_team_games,
    shortened_season = yearID %in% shortened_seasons
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(hr_by_season, aes(x = yearID, y = HR_per_game)) +
  geom_line(color = "grey40") +
  geom_point(
    data = filter(hr_by_season, shortened_season),
    aes(color = "Shortened seasons"),
    size = 2
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Season type",
    values = c("Shortened seasons" = "#D55E00")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Major League Home Runs per Team-Game",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Home runs per team-game",
    caption = "Source: Lahman database"
  )
```

## Comparing seasons

```{r}
season_comparison <- hr_by_season |>
  filter(yearID %in% c(2019, 1981, 1994, 2020)) |>
  mutate(HR_per_game = round(HR_per_game, 3)) |>
  arrange(factor(yearID, levels = c(2019, 1981, 1994, 2020))) |>
  select(yearID, total_HR, total_team_games, HR_per_game)

knitr::kable(
  season_comparison,
  col.names = c("Season", "Total home runs", "Total team-games", "Home runs per game")
)
```
